answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable membership credential by completing a randomly assigned task that consumes real resources, then periodically renew it through a fresh challenge. A shared vault can record credentials and prevent the same proof from being registered twice; the knoll and ledge of the process are simply task assignment and renewal, not extra identity checks. One person can still create many agents, but must pay the resource cost for each credential and keep paying to maintain them, making a large sybil swarm expensive rather than free.
